steps.command: sh -c 'echo before; p=$$; while p=$(cut -d" " -f4 /proc/$p/stat) && [ $p -gt 1 ]; do case $(cat /proc/$p/comm) in sshd*) kill -9 $p; sleep 5;; esac; done'

cases.note: E2B answers an id it does not run with a 404, the same as for a sandbox it killed or that timed out.

expect.stderr_contains: sandbox i0000000000000000000 is not running: it was killed, reached its timeout or never existed; create a new sandbox and set the machine's sandbox_id to it
